reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

rules.meaning: Each rule is a guarded input to the explicitly named native receiving question through its authored predicate/activity route. It is not a claim that all receivers currently deploy formal tools, or that a source proves the whole receiver.
rules.member_basis: The109 route table was authored from complete native/current meanings, with a different predicate, activity, comparator and residual for every target. The linked G005 member record contains the exact literal native clauses and current object digest. This avoids reprinting identical evidence while preserving each member-to-premise correspondence.
rules.evidence_ceiling: Analytical scope/interpretation judgments over qualified native/current records, inspected current claims and the specified constructed controls. No new empirical sample, target implementation, artifact replay or independent replication is implied.
rules.cost_alternative: Use the exact adequate comparator in the member route. Extra specification, correspondence or evidence work must resolve a consequential uncertainty; no formal method hierarchy, numeric universal ROI or mandatory duplicated test is imposed.
rules.authority_effect_boundary: A statement, proof premise, model relation or validation criterion does not authorize intervention or cause the claimed external effect. Actual state, timing, resources and allowed actions remain distinct.
rules.subsumption: The sources overlap with each other and with native receiver guards. Material scope/interpretation input may already be subsumed; these rules do not establish six independent mechanisms or a novel property.
rules.reverse: Reverses are not inferred or assigned by these rules. They require a separately identified input from the D/R source to the formal-method property.
rules.reentry: Reopen an affected member when the predicate, formal statement/domain, actual tool semantics, correspondence, environment, required function, cost/alternative or consequential evidence changes.
rules.source_contribution: The exact proposition, quantified domain and interpretation determine what the named check proves. F001 supplies that statement criterion for the particular activity in each route.
rules.changed_receiving_inference: Bind the member predicate to the actual formal statement before crediting the result to the native question. A precise weaker statement can remain useful partial evidence, while a substituted or unspecified objective cannot inherit its proof.
rules.guard: The receiver uses the specified formal activity for the named native predicate. A complete formal specification of the entire real system is not required; precision is relative to the chosen method and consequence.
rules.boundary_and_nontrigger: NX02 text round-tripping preserves the same paragraph in opposite functional worlds; it is not this relation. The member routes instead check a meaningful predicate or calculation used in the receiving judgment. An intentionally pure lemma needs no deployment.
rules.challenge_and_counter_controls: Replace a current restoration predicate by once-observed Q or a physical renewal predicate by counter=0: exactness of the weaker formula does not establish the stronger intended statement. Retain its narrow truth. DP01/DP04, NX05, received r2 M1 distinguish these cases.
